description: Locks the bb app behind a password, so an unattended window stops exposing your threads. Set the password in Settings, and every window shows an unlock panel until someone enters it. Tick Trust this device once and that browser skips the prompt until the trust window ends. Forgot it? The panel covers the Settings page, so run `bb password-gate reset` in a terminal to open the app again. The lock is the app window, not your data: it does not stop anyone who can run commands on the bb machine or reach its port.
